title: flc-semantic/v1 (Go profile) — semantic facts at a caret (sidecar keyed by sample_id + visibility_policy)
description: Facts are computed with go/types on a snapshot with the hidden target removed (editor_snapshot) or on the prefix only (strict_prefix). Type names are minimal display strings valid at the caret (imported packages shown by package name, own package unqualified). leakage.violations MUST be empty; `goflc validate` fails otherwise.

reason.description: unresolved_receiver_type | unresolved_import | external_imports_unresolved | build_constraint_excluded | package_list_failed | package_too_large | document_text_mismatch | no_package_clause | parse_error | caret_out_of_range | typecheck_no_package | exception:<msg>

receiver_members.description: Fields and methods of the enclosing method's receiver (Go's 'this').

package_members.description: Package-level declarations in scope (all files of the package).

receiver_type.description: Type/package of the selector base after '.'.

members.description: Accessible members of receiver_type after '.'; all applicable candidates, never the single one the target uses.

unresolved_imports.description: Import paths go/types could not resolve offline (external modules not downloaded).

synthetic_suffix.description: strict_prefix only: the closers appended to the prefix (computed from prefix brackets only).

snapshot_repairs.description: Parse-robustness devices applied to the snapshot, both using only visible editor text.

target_identifiers.description: Identifiers tokenized from the hidden target.

mentioned.description: Fact names that also occur in the target — legitimate when the symbol exists independently (coverage).

violations.description: MUST be empty. name_only_in_target:<n> | local_declared_after_caret:<n> | declared_in_synthetic_suffix:<n>.

prompt.description: Compact debug rendering; the model-facing prompt is produced by a separate versioned render step.
